text:
Maya: Quick design check — customer reported a 'ghost jump' in the rules editor when reordering long stacks. Video attached. Jin: Repro'd. Dragging item from ~idx 22 to 6 sometimes lands at 3 after a short pause. Looks like virtualization boundary + snap math issue. Aria: UX suggestions: (1) pause Preview while a reorder gesture is active and show a tiny badge 'Preview paused while editing'; (2) add a 120ms settle before commit so the animation can finish. Dev: Backend note: sim sometimes replies 202 while warming caches. Frontend treats non-200 as error which causes red toast flips. Plan: treat 202 as processing, show inline spinner, and poll once after 1s. Maya: Accessibility: keyboard moves don't announce new position — SR only says 'Saved'. Need an aria-live announcement like 'Moved rule "Block-Auth" to position 4 of 18'. Also drag handle contrast and hit target fail a11y scan. a11y-bot: Scan: drag-handle contrast 2.6:1 (fail). Hit target 18px (fail). Recommend hit target >=44px, role="button" + aria-label, visible focus ring, and aria-live updates on move. Jin: Microinteraction: lower snap threshold near virtualization seams and replace hard snap with a 90ms fade + 110ms translate to preserve spatial context. Also debounce save by 100-150ms. Maya: Copy tweak: replace 'Invalid rule precedence' with 'Order not applied — check for locked rules or circular dependencies.' Toast short: 'Order not saved — resolve dependencies.' Add link to dependency inspector in the long message. Dev: I'll implement 202 handling + spinner, pause preview during active gestures, and add a 120ms settle before dispatching the save. Will emit metric sim.ack.202.count so we can monitor. PR tomorrow. Aria: I'll add the aria-live snippet to the component library:
Moved rule "Block-Auth" to position 4 of 18
. Also draft hotkeys: Alt+Shift+Up/Down and a Move menu (press M) for keyboard users. Maya: Nice. Owners: @Dev client change, @Aria a11y + hotkeys, @Jin microinteraction mock, I'll update the copy + ticket. Sync Fri 10am PT to review. Thanks! :seedling:
